mapper.select: SELECT id, nickname, user_tag, profile_image, quiet_time_start, quiet_time_end, is_expire_warn_enabled, is_reaction_notice_enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM public.profiles WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT p.id AS user_id, u.email, p.nickname, p.user_tag, p.profile_image, 'ACTIVE' AS status, p.quiet_time_start, p.quiet_time_end FROM public.profiles p LEFT JOIN auth.users u ON p.id = u.id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.profiles ( id, nickname, user_tag, profile_image, quiet_time_start, quiet_time_end, is_expire_warn_enabled, is_reaction_notice_enabled, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{nickname}, #{userTag}, COALESCE(#{profileImage}, 'https://hefryhbaoovrhgzevfad.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/profiles/Default%20Profile.png'), COALESCE(#{quietTimeStart}, CAST('21:00:00' AS time)), COALESCE(#{quietTimeEnd}, CAST('08:00:00' AS time)), COALESCE(#{isExpireWarnEnabled}, true), COALESCE(#{isReactionNoticeEnabled}, true), NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE public.profiles SET nickname = #{nickname}, profile_image = #{profileImage}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE public.profiles SET quiet_time_start = #{quietTimeStart}, quiet_time_end = #{quietTimeEnd}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE public.profiles
is_expire_warn_enabled = #{isExpireWarnEnabled},
is_reaction_notice_enabled = #{isReactionNoticeEnabled},
quiet_time_start = #{quietTimeStart},
quiet_time_end = #{quietTimeEnd},
updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE public.recipe SET user_id = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
